About GoldAlert

A free research dashboard for comparing pullbacks across the wider gold ecosystem.

The simulator brings together spot gold, silver, mining shares, exchange-traded funds and gold-backed digital assets. Its core purpose is to make a simple pullback rule visible and testable instead of presenting an unexplained black-box recommendation.

Live charts are powered by TradingView; daily prices used for signal calculations come from Yahoo Finance and CoinGecko. All are third-party sources and may be delayed. The project does not hold customer funds, execute trades or provide individualized investment advice.

GoldAlert · Educational use only
